evidence.title: GitHub - 6551Team/opennews-mcp: News Aggregation · AI Ratings · Trading Signals · Real-time Updates · GitHub

name: OpenNews MCP Server
summary: MCP server feeding AI agents 85+ real-time news, market and prediction sources with AI ratings and trading signals.
description: An MCP server for Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor and other MCP clients. It aggregates 85+ sources across six engine categories (news, listing, onchain, meme, market, prediction), tags every article with a 0-100 impact score, a long/short/neutral trading signal and EN/ZH summaries, and adds keyword search, strategy history and WebSocket real-time subscriptions. An API token from 6551.io is required.
contains: 85+ sources in 6 categories: news 55, listing 9, onchain 2, meme 1, market 6, prediction 12
every article AI-analyzed with impact score 0-100, long/short/neutral signal and EN/ZH summaries
20+ MCP tools: search by coin, source or engine, high-score articles, signal filters
finance tools: company filings, 13F holdings, politician stock disclosures, crypto holdings
WebSocket feed wss://ai.6551.io/open/newswss with coin and engine filters
requires an API token; each REST/MCP call consumes 1 quota
